1
Initiation & Checklist
Site Supervisor, Electrician, or Blasting In-charge fills permit form, statutory checklist & uploads photo.
2
Field Verification
Site Engineer verifies site ground safety & forwards (can Approve or Return; cannot Cancel).
3
Clearances & Domain Approval
Discipline clearances (MEP, P&M, IT, Quality Engineer) followed by Section Head / Tower Incharge review.
4
EHS Safety Endorsement
EHS Safety Manager / Officer conducts final statutory review to activate permit, audit observations, or stop work.

    Worksite Location & Proximity Parameters

    Worksite Physical GPS Tagging On-Site Only

    Safety Rule: Manual entry of coordinate numbers is disabled to prevent incorrect, mistyped, or fraudulent coordinates. The Administrator must physically visit the worksite and capture coordinates directly via device GPS.

    Proximity Circle Radius Range 100 m

    Approvers must be physically located within this radius of the worksite coordinates to authorize permits.

    50m (Strict) 100m (Standard) 150m 200m (Large Site) 300m 500m (Campus)
    Updating coordinates or geofence radius requires Admin DPDP statutory consent & digital signature before saving.
